final: WITH account_stats AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 as region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) as avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), region_stats AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_signed_amount) as avg_amount_avg, AVG(avg_balance) as avg_balance_avg FROM account_stats GROUP BY region), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount_avg) as overall_mean FROM region_stats) SELECT rs.region, rs.avg_amount_avg, rs.avg_balance_avg, rs.avg_amount_avg / om.overall_mean as ratio FROM region_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE om.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
